title: Preservation of the round window
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes, let $a$ be an action on $c$, and let $d$ be a configuration with two additional work tapes. Suppose the input-head position of $d$ is either its position in $c$ or its position after applying $a$, and each of its first $k$ work-tape heads is likewise at the corresponding position in $c$ or after applying $a$. If a configuration $e$ has the same input-head position as $d$ and the same positions for those first $k$ work-tape heads, then $e$ satisfies the same two alternatives for each of these positions.
